fact: In 2024 Niger's mobile money transactions totalled 31,980,545 operations worth 480,220 million FCFA, of which intra-UEMOA transfers were about 1.03% of value, and from 2 November 2026 interoperable e-money transfers in the UEMOA go through PI-SPI, with 13 authorised participants in Niger on the BCEAO list updated 30 September 2026.
title: PI-SPI : impact économique sur le mobile money dans l'AES
